name: Independent TH17 replication of five-game PPO generation 2 native Hard progress
allocation: Four isolated native instances. Four Hard and four Lunatic pairs per lane. Exactly two of four seeds per lane/rank play PPO first. Within-cell order generated by Python Random(1571700) in alpha, beta, gamma, delta order followed by Hard then Lunatic.
primary: Only the Hard paired mean difference in final observed native Stage 1 tick, five-ppo2 minus five-ppo. All sixteen registered Hard pairs count. Positive, negative or null reported. For a failure use its final native Stage 1 tick. A confirmed Stage 1 clear always outranks every failure; assign all clears the same value, one tick greater than the largest Stage 1 last tick observed among all 32 Hard credits with arm labels hidden. This endpoint map is unaffected by any reallocation and preserves the exact physical tick contrast if all fail. We will also report the ceiling, raw ticks and realized clear rates. Missing terminal evidence is a technical failure, never a zero.
inference: Two-sided exact randomization test of the single Hard endpoint at alpha=.05 under the sharp null, conditioning on two first-PPO assignments among four pairs on each lane. Enumerate all 6^4 permissible lane order allocations of the observed first-minus-second outcomes. Also report lane-stratified paired percentile bootstrap (20,000); other endpoints are descriptive.
secondary: Lunatic native Stage 1 end tick, first loss, Stage 2 reached and entry stock, last-playable bombs, remaining lives, and native bomb use in both ranks. Report per-arm and paired estimates. Fresh policy sampler seeds; original game RNG uncontrolled. Previous cohorts are excluded.
controls: Unassisted complete original TH17 0.01a Hard/Lunatic, no Continue. Same four-head camera, original clocks and physical lane within a pair. Prior diagnostic choices and trajectories do not enter the cohort.
scheduling: Four private physical instances are released by study 153 only after both of its held arms complete on that same lane. No overlap with 153 TRAIN or its paired evaluation.
technical: Preserve diagnostic evidence for incomplete technical attempts and retry the identical seed on its assigned lane. Do not replace a qualified loss. No interim primary significance tests.
